Huei-mei Jhou 周惠美
composer
educator

 中文
 Archive
 

 

長笛演奏家周惠美,台灣台北人。畢業於明尼蘇達大學(University of Minnesota) 音樂藝術博士學位, 師事長笛教授Immanuel Davis。惠美曾經在北達科他州和明尼蘇達州教授長笛大師班，其中包括了明Minnesota All-State Band 和 International Music Camp。惠美的博士論文研究Pedagogy of Influential Selected Works by Marcel Moyse: A Modern Perspective, 專攻長笛教育學和法國長笛大師Marcel Moyse的作品並研究教導學生如何運用現代的長笛輔助工具 (breathing bag, breathing builder and finger breath) Marcel Moyse相結合。惠美曾應邀參加明尼蘇達音樂教育協會 (Minnesota Music Education Association) 和明尼蘇達州音樂教師協會 (Minnesota Music Teacher Association)的研討會,研討會上報告的主題是關於在長笛教學法和演奏技巧的呈現上如何搭配呼吸袋(breathing bag)的使用方式。惠美也應邀出席Marcel Moyse協會在芝加哥舉辦的第42屆國家長笛協會(National Flute Association)的論說文比賽。

惠美也參與了各類型的音樂合奏會和室內樂團。目前惠美任教於Princeton High School and the Minnesota Renaissance School。

Notable Accomplishments

Invited to Perform Flute and Read Essay for Marcel Moyse Society, 2014

Selected to Conduct Music Clinic for Minnesota Music Teachers Association, 2014

Publication: Pedagogy of Influential Selected Works by Marcel Moyse: A Modern Perspective

Earned Doctor of Musical Arts from University of Minnesota, studying with flute professor Immanuel Davis

Taught flute masterclasses in North Dakota and Minnesota, including Minnesota All-State Band and International Music Camp

Doctoral dissertation: Pedagogy of Influential Selected Works by Marcel Moyse: A Modern Perspective, focusing on flute pedagogy and modern auxiliary tools (breathing bag, breathing builder, finger breath)

Invited presenter at Minnesota Music Education Association and Minnesota Music Teacher Association conferences on use of breathing bag in flute pedagogy and performance

Invited to present at the Marcel Moyse Society at the 42nd National Flute Association convention in Chicago

Active participant in various ensemble concerts and chamber music groups
